title: Validate decision tasks, outputs, and model capabilities
description:
## Scope

Define label normalization, task identity, typed choice outputs, probability availability, usage, latency, and capability metadata. Reject duplicate/unknown labels, malformed distributions, and unsupported context before a provider call. Do not convert a single confidence into a fabricated full distribution.

## Definition of done

Sentence-named specs cover valid and invalid inputs, missing probability/usage fields, stable fingerprints, and capability rejection; provider-specific response shapes remain in adapters.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Validate decision tasks, outputs, and model capabilities
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given a model declares that it accepts zero-shot choices but no labeled context
    When a caller supplies labeled demonstrations
    Then the adapter rejects the request before making any provider call
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented by the Terra contract sub-agent and reviewed in integration. Added canonical task/result validation, immutable ordered labels (unordered collections rejected), stable task fingerprints, optional probability metadata, capability preflight, conservative Laya context metadata, and adjacent fake-model specs. The cross-module offline decision flow passes for both random and lexical selectors. Specs were run before implementation; final make test: 54 passed. No live model calls. Missing distributions are None; provider rounding values are preserved within the documented tolerance.
